title: fix: repair Polli agent registration
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Addresses the [Polli workflow failure](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/34139320216): its API requires delegated `ag_` credentials, while its production `proxy` listing sends the saved upstream bearer. Adds a guarded manual SQL repair to convert that exact listing to `endpoint_agent`.
- Preserves `pollinations-router/polli`, alias `community/pollinations-router/polli`, provider `community`, and `https://polli.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions` with upstream model `polli`. No Pollinations GPU; no equivalent fallback identified in the registry, so the existing absence of a gateway fallback is preserved.
- Changes billing from wrapper rates of 1.40/4.40 Pollen per million input/output tokens to downstream usage only, with wrapper multiplier `1` and `paidOnly: false`. Applying the repair removes the obsolete encrypted upstream bearer from the listing.
- Keeps production application behind explicit billing/credential-removal approval. Includes backup, rollback, and live verification instructions; preserves hidden state until recovery is verified. Merging this PR does not run the repair.
- Validation: SQLite conversion, idempotence, timestamp units, rate/hidden-state preservation, and 11 mismatch/pending-state guards passed. Biome skips SQL; whitespace check passed. Existing authentication tests could not start because the installed Workers runtime rejects a compatibility flag. Production remains unchanged.

gist.headline: Polli Gets Her Badge Back
gist.blurb: A guarded repair script is ready for Polli’s registration paperwork: the agent listing can be switched to delegated credentials without disturbing its model, aliases, or hidden state. The old upstream bearer gets composted once recovery is approved.
gist.summary: Added an idempotent, approval-gated SQL repair that converts the production pollinations-router/polli listing from proxy to endpoint_agent so Polli can use delegated ag_ credentials, sets downstream-only billing with multiplier 1 and paidOnly false, and removes the obsolete encrypted upstream bearer.
gist.impact: Once explicitly applied and verified, Polli’s existing https://polli.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions endpoint and polli upstream model can register with the credential type its API expects while preserving its community aliases, rates, and hidden state.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is restoring her agent-registration badge at a cozy community router desk: a guarded repair checklist converts a little proxy sign into an endpoint_agent sign, while an old sealed bearer-token envelope is safely placed in a compost bin. Include a retro terminal showing a small ag_ credential badge, plus flowers and code-vines to represent careful recovery; Polli should wear a tiny mechanic tool belt and look quietly satisfied.
